result.summary: Several layout and truncation issues affect restaurant cards and category chips, plus incomplete bottom navigation labels that hurt usability.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol...) is cut off at the right edge, with the name truncated and only a partial image visible.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll areas show full cards or add proper peek/padding so names and images are not clipped; consider responsive card widths.

issues.description: The bottom tab bar shows an empty label under the third icon (between Search and Profile), so the Orders tab text is missing or invisible.
issues.suggestion: Restore the 'Orders' label with the same styling as other tabs and verify icon-to-label alignment.

issues.description: Category filter chips overflow the screen; 'Healthy' is partially cut off and a further chip is only a sliver on the right.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scrolling with adequate end padding or wrap/resize chips so all options are fully visible.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated mid-word without ellipsis treatment that preserves readability.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent text overflow (ellipsis) and ensure enough card width or two-line titles for longer names.
